description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

description.zh:
待查询服务所属的MSE集群ID。
>  InstanceId与ClusterId其中一个必填。
description.en:
The ID of the MSE instance to which the service belongs.

>  You must specify InstanceId or ClusterId.

description.zh:
服务所属集群名字。
> 此处集群为nacos服务中的概念，非MSE集群。
description.en:
The name of the cluster to which the service belongs.

> The cluster is a concept for Nacos services and is not equivalent to a Microservices Engine (MSE) instance.
The group to which the service belongs.

description.zh:
当前查询服务的集群ID。
>  InstanceId与ClusterId其中一个必填。
description.en:
The ID of the instance to which the service belongs.

> You must specify InstanceId or ClusterId.
The namespace to which the service belongs.
The number of the page to return.
The number of entries to return on each page.
The extended request parameters in the JSON format.

description.zh: 查询指定的服务名信息。
description.en: The name of the service whose listeners you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse get-service-listeners --service-name zeekr-orderboss --group-name WEB_GROUP --namespace-id ddaf8f12-0000-b1c1-86e7c72e266b --cluster-name DEFAULT --has-ip-count none --cluster-id mse-09k1q110000 --instance-id mse_prepaid_public_cn-tl32odtt20j --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --request-pars example-string --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
